        MIN(lot_id) AS lot_id,
        cas_number,
        name,
        SUM(quantity) AS quantity,
        'SHAVER LAB' AS location,
        '' AS notes

)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(t.csv_row, '') FROM (
    SELECT header_line || CHR(10) ||
           'Deduplicated Reagent Catalog by CAS Number' || CHR(10) ||
           'CAS Number,Cas,Reagent Name,Quantity,Location' || CHR(10) ||
           '————— —— – —-————' || CHR(10) || 
           (
               SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(
                   CAST(cas_number AS TEXT) || ',' || name || ',' || CAST(quantity AS TEXT) || ',' || location || CHR(10),
                   ''
               ) FROM (
                   SELECT 
                       MIN(lot_id) AS lot_id,
                       cas_number,
                       name,
                       SUM(quantity) AS quantity,
                       'SHAVER LAB' AS location
                   FROM reagents
                   GROUP BY cas_number
                   ORDER BY cas_number
               )
            )
    ) AS csv_row;
